evidence.reason: `render_units` reads unit templates recursively with `git ls-tree -r` (lines 681-684), keeps every `crq-*` basename, then writes each rendered unit to `output / source.name` (line 707). If the tree contains two templates with the same basename in different subdirectories, the later write overwrites the earlier one; `paths` then contains the same target twice, so the subsequent verification checks only the surviving file twice and cannot detect the loss. This is a routine correctness fix in existing rendering behavior, not a new protection requirement.
